source: Meetup city search, rounds 20-21 (40 affluent suburbs and resort towns)
note: Two listings, both Charlotte. Round 21's twenty wealthy suburbs — Bethesda, Wellesley, Lake Forest, Chappaqua, Piedmont, Manhattan Beach — returned three mahjong groups and no candidates: all were already known. That is the fourth sweep in a row where the suburb tier is exhausted.

listings.name: 50 Shades of Menopause — MahJongg Thursdays
listings.description: Weekly Thursday lunchtime MahJongg around Charlotte, at a different venue each week — recent ones include The Clubhouse, Amelie's, Hawthornes, Rusty Onion, Local Draft, Crossridge Cafe, The Craic and McAlister's Blakeney. Check the group's calendar for the week's spot; it is named in each event's title.
listings.howToJoin: Join the Meetup group and RSVP. The venue changes weekly and is named in the event title, so check the calendar before setting off.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Matthews and Huntersville. 9 upcoming sessions, every Thursday 12:00-15:00 from 3 September to 29 October, with Meetup recording "Every week on Thursday". A ROTATING VENUE, NOT NINE SESSIONS: each event is titled MahJongg plus that week's venue in capitals, so keyed on a three-word title stem this came through as nine separate candidates for one weekly game. Discovery now collapses a title that opens with the game name to that word, since the rest is labelling the instance. No venue is recorded because there is no single one, and Meetup carries no venue record for any of them; the venues named in the titles are listed in the description instead. STYLE NOT STATED by the organiser — recorded as american on the base rate for US social play; confirm before relying on it.

listings.name: Pals and Confidants — Mah Jongg
listings.description: Saturday afternoon Mah Jongg in Charlotte, run by the Pals and Confidants group. The venue address is shared with members after RSVP rather than published.
listings.howToJoin: Join the Meetup group and RSVP; the address is given to attendees on RSVP.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Matthews. 3 upcoming "Mah Jongg!!" sessions, Saturdays 13:50-16:30 on 12, 19 and 26 September — three consecutive Saturdays, which is what makes it weekly; Meetup records no series. The 1:50pm start is the organiser's, not a rounding error. NO ADDRESS ON PURPOSE: the events carry "venue": null with eventType PHYSICAL, so the organiser has not published one; the city is the group's own registered city. STYLE NOT STATED by the organiser — recorded as american on the base rate for US social play; confirm before relying on it.
